instructions: Success Stories FAQ only (entrepreneur My Success Stories). Home testimonials are separate. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour.

faqs.question: What is Success Stories on TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: My Success Stories lets entrepreneurs share how TEF impacted their business, track drafts/submissions, and submit one story for admin review. Not a public gallery here.

faqs.question: Same as Home testimonials?
faqs.answer: No. Home testimonials are a separate marketing carousel. Alumni profile success highlights are also separate.

faqs.question: Who can use Success Stories?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs with completed profile see it in the side menu. Mentors do not. Sign-in required.

faqs.question: How many success stories can I submit?
faqs.answer: One. Creating another redirects to the existing story. Edit/resubmit when allowed.

faqs.question: How do I share my success story?
faqs.answer: Success Stories → Share your success story (if none yet) → complete Personal, Business, Story, Attachments → Save draft and/or Submit for review.

faqs.question: What information is on the form?
faqs.answer: Personal names/email/phone/gender; Business funding year/country/name/description; Story description, optional article URL, social handles, optional comments; Attachments 1–10 images/PDF on submit.

faqs.question: What statuses can my story have?
faqs.answer: Draft, Pending review, Approved, Rejected. List shows Business name, Status, Submitted, Response Date, Action.

faqs.question: When can I edit or submit?
faqs.answer: When canEdit/canSubmit allow. Pending/approved typically view-only on list. Detail confirm: Submit for review?

faqs.question: Story rejected — what next?
faqs.answer: Open story → read Admin remark → revise → Submit for review again when allowed.

faqs.question: Attachment rules?
faqs.answer: Images or PDF; at least 1 and up to 10 on submit.

faqs.question: What can I not do?
faqs.answer: No multiple stories; no public feed here; no delete control; no dedicated video feature; Share means start your submission, not social network share.

faqs.question: Can I save a draft?
faqs.answer: Yes. Save draft without all submit-required fields; filled values still length/format-checked. Continue draft from list/banner.

faqs.question: Empty list message?
faqs.answer: No success stories yet.

faqs.question: Edit vs View.
faqs.answer: Edit when editable; View when pending/approved/read-only.

faqs.question: Gender options?
faqs.answer: Male or Female.

faqs.question: Social media handles required on submit?
faqs.answer: Yes on submit (max 2000).

faqs.question: Article URL required?
faqs.answer: Optional; must be http/https if provided.

faqs.question: Business description max length?
faqs.answer: Up to 10,000 characters for business/success/additional text fields.

faqs.question: Unsafe HTML in text?
faqs.answer: HTML tags / javascript: links are rejected.

faqs.question: Pending review meaning?
faqs.answer: Submitted and waiting for admin review; typically not editable on list.

faqs.question: Approved meaning?
faqs.answer: Accepted; view submission; editing typically unavailable.

faqs.question: I already have a story but clicked create.
faqs.answer: You are redirected to the existing story detail.

faqs.question: Only PDF and images?
faqs.answer: File picker accepts image/* and .pdf.

faqs.question: Admin remark where?
faqs.answer: On the detail form when present — important after rejection.

faqs.question: Columns on the table?
faqs.answer: Business name, Status, Submitted, Response Date, Action.

faqs.question: Page title?
faqs.answer: My Success Stories.

faqs.question: Subtitle meaning?
faqs.answer: Share how TEF has impacted your business. Track drafts and submissions in one place.

faqs.question: Delete my success story?
faqs.answer: No delete/withdraw control in this entrepreneur frontend.

faqs.question: Public browse of all stories?
faqs.answer: Not in this Success Stories route tree.

faqs.question: Video upload feature?
faqs.answer: No dedicated video feature in this submission form.

faqs.question: Continue draft CTA.
faqs.answer: Status banner/list can offer continue draft when the primary story is draft.

faqs.question: Revise rejected CTA.
faqs.answer: Banner/list can prompt revise rejected story.

faqs.question: First/last name max?
faqs.answer: 100 characters.

faqs.question: Email max?
faqs.answer: 255; required on submit.

faqs.question: Year of funding max?
faqs.answer: 20 characters.

faqs.question: Response Date column.
faqs.answer: Shows review/response date when available.

faqs.question: Submit on new vs detail.
faqs.answer: New page can Submit; detail uses Submit for review with confirm dialog.

faqs.question: Feed Success Story badge?
faqs.answer: Post type badge in other modules — not this submission form.

faqs.question: Mentors Success Stories menu?
faqs.answer: No mentor menu item.

faqs.question: Profile must be complete?
faqs.answer: Yes — incomplete profiles are redirected away.

faqs.question: Country list source.
faqs.answer: Business country options load from profile countries list.

faqs.question: Read-only attachments.
faqs.answer: Open as links in read-only view.

faqs.question: Alumni Success Stories tab?
faqs.answer: Alumni Community profile highlights are separate from entrepreneur My Success Stories API.
